parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description:
The name of the database account.

> If you omit this parameter, information about all database accounts is returned.

parameters.name: AccountType
parameters.description:
The account type. By default, accounts of all types are returned. Valid values:

- **Normal**: a standard account.

- **Super**: a privileged account.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in a specific region.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the tag.

> You can call the [TagResources](~~179253~~) operation to create a tag for a cluster.
